title: Personal Credit Cards: penalty APR, trigger, cure count and military APR cap by tier
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: penalty APR and military APR cap figures

This rate card covers the Personal Credit Cards line. It lists, for every card tier, the penalty APR, how many days a minimum payment must be past due before that APR applies, how many consecutive on-time minimum payments remove it, and the APR cap that applies to every balance while the customer's military status is active duty.

## Rate table

| Card tier | Penalty APR | Days past due before the penalty APR applies | Consecutive on-time minimum payments that remove it | APR cap while on active duty |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 29.99% | 60 days | 6 | 6.00% |
| College Rewards Visa | 29.99% | 60 days | 6 | 6.00% |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 29.99% | 60 days | 6 | 6.00% |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 29.99% | 60 days | 6 | 6.00% |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 29.99% | 60 days | 6 | 6.00% |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | not applicable | 60 days | 6 | 6.00% |

## What the columns mean

- **Penalty APR**: the APR applied once the penalty APR is triggered; "not applicable" means the tier has no penalty APR.
- **Days past due before it applies**: the days a minimum payment must be past due before the penalty APR applies, in whole days.
- **On-time payments that remove it**: the number of consecutive on-time minimum payments after which the penalty APR is removed.
- **APR cap while on active duty**: the cap on every balance's APR while the customer's military status is active duty.

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Does Visa Infinite Private Client carry a penalty APR?**
A: No. Its penalty APR is not applicable, even though the trigger and cure figures are listed for the tier.

**Q: Does the active-duty cap differ by tier?**
A: No. Every tier carries the same cap of 6.00%.
